unreachable: Your PC could not be reached. Check that Xyra is still open and that you are on the same network.
offline: Your PC cannot be reached. Tap to retry.

pairing.title: Xyra on your phone
pairing.text: Connect the app with Xyra on your PC and use it all from here: accept matches, follow champion select, your build and the meta.
pairing.codeChanged: This phone was disconnected from your PC or the code changed. Scan it again to go on.

steps.open: On your PC open Xyra → Settings → Phone.
steps.turnOn: Turn the link on and accept the Windows prompt.
steps.scan: Tap the button below and scan the code.

pairing.invalid: That is not a Xyra code. Scan the one in Settings → Phone on your PC.
pairing.private: The app talks straight to your PC over your network: nothing goes through the internet.
pairing.expired: That code is no longer valid: scan the one shown now in Settings → Phone on your PC.

live.idle: Queue up on your PC: here you can accept the match and follow champion select and your game.
live.notAllowed: Your PC does not let this phone accept matches. Change it in Settings → Phone.

build.pick: Search a champion to see its build.

settings.title: Xyra on the PC

auto_accept.title: Accept matches by itself
auto_accept.description: Xyra accepts the match for you after a few seconds.

auto_import_build.title: Import build by itself
auto_import_build.description: Runes, spells and items when you pick a champion.

paused.title: Pause Xyra
paused.description: It neither reads the screen nor draws labels.

settings.forgetHint: To connect it again you will have to scan the code again.
settings.readOnly: You can only see them: your PC does not let this phone change settings.
